corrections.text: The summary says Artificial Analysis' Decision Index data "scores it between Jev 1.14 and OpenAI's entry." That is true of those three entries, but the same page lists 18 decision models by default and eight of them score higher than Gemini Decision 1's 65.98 (including Drex Max v1.1 at 72.62, SubQ Snap 1.2 at 72.58, GLiDE v1.2 at 72.52 and Mammoth 27B at 71.36); Gemini Decision 1 ranks ninth of 18 on the index. The article compares only the models that appear in Google's own table.
